Facts:
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic was the 30th annual edition of the event.
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic was the first Grand Slam event of the Women's World Curling Tour.
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic was held from October 5 to 9 at the Calgary Curling Club in Calgary, Alberta.
- Jennifer Jones won the 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic with teammates Cathy Overton-Clapham, Jill Officer, and Dawn Askin.
- The 2007 Trail Appliances Autumn Gold Curling Classic had a total purse of $56,000, and Jennifer Jones's team received $14,000 for winning.
- Jennifer Jones won the 2008 World Women's Curling Championship, and her team was the last Canadian women's team to do so until Rachel Homan in 2017.
- Jennifer Jones won the 2008 Scotties Tournament of Hearts and therefore had already qualified for the 2009 Manitoba Scotties Tournament of Hearts as Team Canada.
- Jennifer Jones won an Olympic gold medal as skip of the Canadian team at the 2014 Sochi Games.
